goals: Prevent FrozenLib's cape-registration cached executor from delaying or watchdog-failing client shutdown while preserving the executor's ordinary asynchronous behavior.
scope: For exact FrozenLib 2.5.3-mc26.2 on Minecraft Java 26.2, redirect only the no-argument Executors.newCachedThreadPool() invocation in CapeUtil.registerCapesFromURL(String) to a cached pool whose default-style workers are daemon threads.
Preserve Java's default worker naming, priority, thread group, and FrozenLib's asynchronous cape-registration behavior, with a required exact target and invocation that fail closed on drift.

exclusions: Global executor interception, FastQuit integration, lifecycle waits, request interruption, and shutdown changes outside the exact FrozenLib cape-registration call site.
FrozenLib's separate resource-pack download executor, whose file-writing task could be abandoned if daemonized at process exit.
FrozenLib classes or assets, upstream redistribution, and compatibility with FrozenLib versions other than exact 2.5.3-mc26.2.
A successor canary, new shutdown investigation, Minecraft deployment, Test Slot ownership, or Test Instance Manager changes without a separate task.
